CoreItera is a global technology company that provides AI services for the next million responsible businesses.

We start by helping mental health firms grow from 10 to their first 1,000 clients in 2027, with minimum resources.

Reduce mental health stress by helping expert firms operate at scale.

title: Executive summary: a small, proven tool first, then 700 bureaus
note: All numbers are estimates from the CoreItera model (model/inputs.py); details in the appendix.
body_html:
1. SituationToo few psychologists (3 per 100,000 in ASEAN). Indonesian bureaus win clients in Instagram and WhatsApp chats.
  2. ProblemFounders and admins are stuck in a loop: hundreds of leads, under 5% close, founders re-teach SOPs 2 to 4 hours a week, schedules are matched in spreadsheets, feedback is never asked.
  3. SolutionA small MVP that fixes each step: a 24-hour sales agent in the bureau's own style, self-booking, and feedback requests. Tested at TemanJourney first.
  4. Plan243 bureaus signed by December 2027, 700 paying in year 2, Malaysia or Singapore in year 3. Psynthesia seats from year 2.
  5. AskRp30M now (TemanJourney Rp20M, Riskia Rp10M) for 20%: Riskia 16.1%, TemanJourney 3.9%.

title: Tax rules behind the numbers
note: Checked against DJP and tax-news sources (DDTC, IKPI), October 2026. Not tax advice: a tax consultant should confirm that 2027 is the last 0.5% year. VAT (PPN) is added to our prices once turnover passes Rp4.8 billion, so it is not a cost here.
body_html:
RuleWhat it means for PT CoreItera
0.5% of turnover (PP 55/2022)Only for turnover up to Rp4.8 billion a year, and for a PT only for its first 3 tax years. Since PP 20/2026 (April 2026), a PT can no longer start using it, but PTs already using it keep it until their 3 years end. PT CoreItera was registered on 10 October 2025 and uses it today, so it keeps 0.5% for tax years 2025, 2026 and 2027.
22% of profit (UU HPP)The normal company tax, on profit after costs, not on turnover.
Pasal 31E cutIf turnover is up to Rp50 billion, the part of profit that matches the first Rp4.8 billion of turnover pays half (11%). So the average rate rises from 11% as turnover grows.
LossesA loss year pays no company tax, and the loss lowers taxable profit for the next 5 years.
PTKPThe personal allowance is for people, not for a PT. It lowers each founder's own salary tax (PPh 21), which is already inside their gross pay.
Cash timingEach month we pay last year's tax / 12 (PPh 25); the rest of last year's tax is paid in April (PPh 29).

title: Five tests this business must pass
body_html:
TestEvidenceConfidence
1. Is the pain big?Late replies lose clients; founders re-teach selling.Medium: count late chats at TemanJourney, Dec 2026
